impacts.text: Every user who lets their lock reach its natural expiry loses 100% of their rewards for the final epoch in which they were bonded.
The user was bonded for a part or all of that epoch, yet received nothing.
This affects 100% of locks that reach their natural expiry without manual extension to unlock time.

For the worst case, users who lock for any duration <= epochLength (including the minimum allowed e.g MINTIME = epochLength = 14 days) can lose 100% of their rewards, since the lock can start and expire within the same epoch, leaving no epoch where the end-snapshot captures a non-zero balance.
The user can never claim epoch N rewards — they are gone.
Guaranteed loss of the final epoch's rewards for every expiring lock.
lock that reaches its locked.end loses 100% of rewards for the epoch in which it expires.
Up to 100% total reward loss for lockers with duration <= epochLength
A user bonded for an entire epoch receiving 0% of their share violates this guarantee.
No mitigation without cost - the only escape is extending the lock (more capital lockup than intended), and the user has no way to know they need to do this.
